method: Primary-source checks by Codex. Offering-level evidence only; does not confirm a buyer design, site availability, SLA or contract. Original imported claims and dates remain unchanged.

bt.summary: BT describes an end-to-end managed SASE service. Contractual service boundaries, policy tasks, licences and service levels must be agreed for the proposed package.

gtt.summary: GTT Secure Connect offers end-to-end management and retained co-management rights. Confirm the chosen service level and responsibility matrix.

opensystems.summary: Open Systems describes lifecycle management of underlay and overlay, with a 24/7 operations centre. Obtain the scope, exclusions and location-specific service levels.

expereo.summary: Expereo describes running day-to-day SASE operations. Confirm the platform, security tasks, change process and service boundary in the order.

lumen.summary: Lumen offers Pro-Managed and Self-Managed SASE. The service guide excludes SOC services from Pro-Managed: the buyer retains security-event monitoring and response unless separately purchased.

att.summary: AT&T describes fully managed SASE offerings with Cisco and Palo Alto Networks. Select the actual platform and verify retained buyer responsibilities.

comcastbusiness.summary: Comcast Business explicitly offers fully managed and co-managed SASE. Features and availability vary; agree the exact security policy and operating responsibilities.

ntt-data.summary: NTT DATA describes fully managed Prisma SASE with lifecycle operation and 24/7 support. This is evidence for that named service, not every NTT offering.

colt.summary: Colt’s Versa SASE service guide specifies self-management, customer policy changes and separate SD-WAN/SASE portals. A managed SD-WAN contract must not be assumed to include managed SASE operations.

verizon.summary: Verizon SASE Management operates specified customer-licensed security-cloud instances. Package scope varies; the customer creates policy rules and must meet the service-guide prerequisites.

aryaka.summary: Aryaka publishes managed, co-managed and self-managed delivery choices. Confirm the selected mode, security tasks, site/user licences and separately ordered last-mile services.

virgin-media-o2.summary: Virgin Media O2 Business describes SASE design, deployment and managed services across named vendor platforms. The precise operating model and retained buyer tasks remain unconfirmed.

orangebusiness.summary: Orange publishes several SD-WAN platforms and customer portal controls. A specific platform and SASE service boundary must be selected before management responsibilities can be confirmed.

velocloud.summary: Broadcom’s lifecycle notice states that VeloCloud SASE secured by Symantec SKUs stopped sale on 1 July 2025 and Arista support ended on 30 June 2026. This specific retired bundle is excluded from current products; it does not mean all VeloCloud SD-WAN is retired. Confirm the current SSE integration and support path.
